readme: Optional. Copy this file to local/qb-config.local.json (git-ignored) and set sender to the email address of the classic Outlook account to send from. recipients is a list of zero or more email addresses; an empty list sends to sender. The sender need not be listed and is not automatically copied. With no sender, reports are saved to local/reports and no email is sent. pluginRoot is optional: leave it blank unless your Copilot plugins are not under COPILOT_HOME or ~/.copilot/installed-plugins.
